Setup.Name: Usage of Mappings
Setup.Description: Uses a mapping to map an id to a human readable name.
Setup.Manifest:
Mappings:
  - Name: "IdToName"
    Entries: 
      - From: "1234"
        To: "sensor one"
      - From: "4321"
        To: "sensor two"


Processors:
  - Name: "Processor Temperature"
    Description: "Reads the sensor id from the topic and converts it into a human readable form using mappings."
    Mqtt: 
      Subscriptions:
        - Topic: "sensor/+/raw"
    Otel:
      Metrics:
        - Name: "Processor.Temperature"
          Description: "The current processor temperature."
          Instrument: Gauge
          Attributes:
            - Key: "Sensor name"
              Value: "$(Map(TopicPath('[1]'), 'IdToName'))"
          Value: "PAYLOAD()"
